edits.current:
When a synchronous host callback returns a selected `Subtype`, both targets
generate `with_recovery($callback, $value)`. Supply a valid value for the exact
callback result shape. The generated boundary checks that recovery before the
callback can run, checks the callback's actual reply with the selected Lean
constructor, and never treats the recovery as successful output. A returned
Lean closure checks selected `Subtype` inputs before its body runs and remains
usable after rejection. Host-only callback parameters do not acquire closure
lease entry points.

The [PHP-Wasm callback Subtype qualification](../evidence/callback-subtype-php-wasm-local-qualification-20261022.md)
covers ordinary source and independently reviewed Binding IR through reproduced
Composer API, npm component and npm shared-runtime archives, source removal,
offline installation, relocation, and twelve Node/Chromium executions per
route. Publish those archives with the existing
[PHP-Wasm npm and Composer flow](#php-wasm-with-npm); consumers do not need the
author project or Lean toolchain.

[PHP-Wasm owned Subtype checks](../evidence/owned-subtype-php-wasm-local-qualification-20261022.md) add one proof-erased `Int` field inside the tested acyclic `Bundle` owner on both source routes. Source-free offline packages are physically relocated before eight Node and eight Chromium executions per route cover borrowed and transferred inputs, leased results, exact constructor selection, rejection before transfer, explicit retain/close behavior, queued-finalizer cleanup and request recovery. [PHP-Wasm owned checked-record checks](../evidence/owned-checked-record-php-wasm-local-qualification-20261022.md) add the tested copied `Window` inside `Booking` and the proof-backed `Claim` across `Ticket` owners, transfers, synchronous callbacks and returned Lean closures on both source routes. Invalid explicit recovery rejects before callback entry; standalone result-only packages retain no checked-input or callback metadata. Recursive owned graphs, retained or asynchronous callbacks and broader predicates remain separate work. [PHP-Wasm callback Subtype checks](../evidence/callback-subtype-php-wasm-local-qualification-20261022.md) add synchronous host callback replies and returned Lean closure inputs on both source routes. Two author roots reproduce the Composer API, npm component and npm shared-runtime archives before source removal, offline installation and relocation. Eight Node and four Chromium startup/lazy, weak/strict contexts per route check scalar, mixed and nested copied carriers, exact typed recovery, exception identity, cleanup and later-call recovery. Retained or asynchronous callbacks, arbitrary predicates, recursive or generic refined payloads, owned callback payloads, dispatch counts and memory bounds remain separate work.
